intent: Expand owner-facing curated source VIDEO catalog with visually diverse warm sunlight videos, not still images
licenseSafety: Individual pages advertised Mixkit Stock Video Free commercial/personal terms on review date; license and person/brand/derivative rights must be rechecked before physical import; restricted items excluded.
nextProcessing: Re-open each official video page and verify current per-clip Free vs Restricted terms
Obtain original MP4 via permitted manual provider download and preserve source URL
Probe actual video codec, resolution, fps, length and SHA256; validate non-static motion and frames
Review faces/brands/subjects and artistic sunlight/framing across 9- and 16-9 shots
Review crop to 1:1 and opposite aspect; do not mislabel a crop as native footage
Use existing local licensed-MP4 or cost-gated private R2 ingest, then confirm generator playback/export
Only after rights, human approval, technical readback and LIVE checks move records out of CANDIDATE_RESEARCH_ONLY
